# Cohort Comms

> Official communications platform for the Hult Cohort Developer Program
> (Summer Pilot 2026, Week 2 winner). Open signup with GitHub/Google; pending
> accounts get a personal space; admins admit people into the cohort workspace
> (bell join_request + /admin roster). Channels, DMs, threads, reactions,
> search, typing, image attach — plus Forth embed, deep-link cards, and an
> inbound webhook receiver (Forth does not send outbound events).

## Links

- [Production app](https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app): sign in / register.
- [Interactive demo](https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app/demo): no account; local-only walkthrough.
- [Source code](https://github.com/priyanshshahh/cohort-comms): Next.js 16 app.
- [Forth project board](https://forth-bice.vercel.app): PM platform this integrates with.
- [Submission pull request](https://github.com/rogerSuperBuilderAlpha/hult-cohort-program/pull/118): cohort record.

## Stack

Next.js 16.2 (App Router), React 19, Auth.js v5 (GitHub + Google OAuth), Neon
Postgres via Drizzle ORM, optional Vercel Blob, deployed on Vercel. Realtime:
SSE `/api/events` + SWR fallback.

## Access

- Anyone can register (GitHub or Google).
- New accounts are `pending`: personal channels only; cohort channels/DMs closed.
- Admins are notified (`join_request`) and admit at `/admin` (or email allowlist).
- Admitted members (`active`) get the full cohort workspace.

## Features (signed-in)

- Seeded + member-created channels; #announcements admin-only post
- 1:1 DMs; one-level threads; reactions; FTS + ⌘K
- Unread, presence, typing, @mention bell, image attach, light/dark
- Forth embed + deep-link cards + inbound webhook receiver

## Routes

- `/` — landing (public); signed-in → `/c/general`
- `/demo` — interactive walkthrough (public, local state)
- `/sign-in` — GitHub / Google via Auth.js (public)
- `/c/[slug]`, `/dm/[userId]` — chat (auth; cohort scopes need admission)
- `/admin` — roster (admins)
- `/api/admin/members` — admit / revoke / allowlist
- `/api/webhooks/forth` — inbound board events (shared-secret)

## Not implemented

Message edit/delete, nested threads, group DMs, push/email notifications,
automatic Forth → chat on ticket ship.
